name: Introduce IRegistry to unify IEntity, INamespaced, and IPatchable
summary: Existing structure: IEntity (entity.ts) requires patch(); INamespaced (fuzzy-namespace.ts) requires namespace(); patch() methods scattered on Forma. Goal: Create IRegistry interface to unify these contracts and eliminate scattered patch implementations.
